source_limitations: MetaRouter integration is beta and explicitly permits custom events/parameters/mappings.
MetaRouter requires IP/user-agent mapping for user matching quality, not universal event acceptance. PRX exact-route example omits IP, so absence is not rejected.
MetaRouter timestamp mapping and PRX randomstr cachebuster are both preserved. No timestamp units or bounds were inferred.
Opaque path/query ID equality remains unimplemented: current path parser decodes plus as space and equal_values observes only the first scalar occurrence. No new core change is requested.
VideoAmp public API/CLI docs concern authenticated planning/reporting APIs, not the beacon receiver. Official GitHub inventory and archived supergrep source do not provide this collector schema.
No source supports forcing HTTP method, MIME, body shape, UUID/numeric ID grammar, DNT enum or a closed event vocabulary.
Physical path captures are nonempty-only. They never impose alphanumeric/UUID grammar, and query/form values cannot repair an empty physical slot.
Bare URL keys are omitted by the legacy extractor; bare form keys are retained. URL/form precedence remains an explicit parser behavior, not receiver policy.
